body: Part A G4: traps 7/41 (all busts: Enphase, Celsius, KPIT, Tata Elxsi, Alkyl, Symphony, Adani), winners 4/57. Verdict: MOVE to stage 5 (P/E vs own median, reverse DCF; L12 '2x own median = flat 4-6 yrs').
title: Trailing P/E >50 caught 7 of 9 busts at their peaks but also stood at the start of Trent (155x -> 19x), Deepak Nitrite (~69x -> 12x), Kaynes (104x -> 10x) and DMart; it is a stage-5 valuation input, not a stage-2 filter
